messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 95th percentile latency and increased 5xxs for inference traffic in us-west-2a. Auto-alert triggered (rule: inference_tail_latency > 1.2s for 3m). Routing impact: ~15% of regional traffic from us-west-2 routed to us-west-2a. Paging oncall: @michelle_oncall. Please acknowledge and triage.

michelle_oncall: acknowledged. pulling grafana now. suspected network plane or resolver. tagging #oncall-handoff if needed.

jordan_sre: seeing a spike in GRPC stream errors (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) originating from gw-proxy-usw2a. 95p tokens latency ~1.7s, error rate from that AZ ~8%. other AZs steady.

ash_engops: checking infra: control plane and instance health look fine, but ENI RX drops on a subset of instances in subnet-az1a. AWS health shows no global event. opening an AWS case.

michelle_oncall: immediate mitigation options?: 1) steer traffic away from az-us-west-2a via routing policy, 2) reduce batching on clients to lower tail latency, 3) fall back to smaller quantized model for affected pools. leaning to (1) + (3).

kevin_platform: can we do graceful reroute at the LB level? I can change target weights for the regional NLB to shift ~30% traffic off the AZ. will push in 30s unless objections. :eyes:

support_liz: Customer impact: support dashboard shows a small set of customers (5 customers, high throughput) reporting increased latency and occasional 502s. CS notified. Logging merchant_ids: m_102, m_443.

michelle_oncall: go ahead Kevin. also enable model-fallback policy for pools serving those merchant_ids (switch to model-x-small-quantized) to reduce error rate. Jordan, can you run the KV cache warmup after the fallback?

jordan_sre: starting fallback rollout: canary on 3 instances, enabling cache-populate endpoint. snippet: ```sh
curl -X POST https://orchestrator.internal/v1/rollout \
  -d '{"pool":"inference-pool-a","variant":"model-x-small-quant","pct":10}'
```

ash_engops: NLB weights updated: us-west-2a -> 60%, us-west-2b -> 25%, us-west-2c -> 15%. monitoring for client errors.

incident-bot: NOTE: Runbook step executed: traffic_steer_nlb_weight_change by kevin_platform at 3765432148.

jordan_sre: canary results after 1 min: errors from canary instances dropped to baseline, tail latency -20%. beginning progressive rollout to remaining affected pools.

michelle_oncall: great. keep the steer in place for 30m, continue rollout, and coordinate customer comms. ask CS to start templated message. if errors reappear, we escalate to cross-region failover.

support_liz: CS message prepared and queued, will send after 15m observation window. impacted customers flagged for priority support.

kevin_platform: monitoring dashboards: TTL of DNS lookups for gw-proxy in az1a spiked around the same time. Could be resolver slowpath causing connection churn. opened ticket with infra DNS team.

michelle_oncall: thanks all. current status: partial traffic steer active, model fallback rolling, customer comms queued. next update in 10m or on-call handoff if needed. :thumbsup:
